architectural_fidelity.reason: Room is clearly recognizable with preserved brick wall, two windows in correct positions, white walls on right, dark hardwood floors, ceiling height maintained, and same camera viewpoint retained.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost traces, remnants, or phantom shadows visible on the clean floor.

style_commitment.reason: Strong industrial style execution with exposed brick wall preserved, industrial track lighting with Edison bulbs, exposed beam detail on ceiling, leather mid-century chairs, metal and wood furniture pieces, and minimal raw aesthetic—unmistakably committed to industrial design vocabulary.

editorial_density.reason: Room lacks Architectural Digest-level styling: no wall art, only 2 plants visible, minimal layered textiles (no throws, pillows, rugs), no styled surface vignettes, no books or decorative objects, and feels more like empty staging than a lived-in editorial spread.

photorealism.reason: Lighting is coherent with realistic shadows, materials have proper texture (brick, leather, wood grain visible), no plastic CGI feel, and overall photographic quality is convincing.

designer_preference_reason: While Cova preserves architecture beautifully and commits to industrial style, the sparse editorial density makes it feel incomplete compared to Collov's fully realized, layered staging approach.
what_cova_does_better: Preserves original architectural character including exposed brick wall
Maintains authentic room proportions and viewpoint
Commits to a specific industrial aesthetic rather than generic neutral style
Shows strong understanding of industrial design vocabulary with appropriate material choices
what_collov_does_better: Achieves full Architectural Digest-level editorial styling with layered textiles and accessories
Creates lived-in feel with abundant decorative details and surface vignettes
Demonstrates higher density of plants and decorative objects throughout
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add large-scale wall art—industrial photography, abstract metal art, or vintage signage
Layer in area rugs to define seating zone and add warmth
Add minimum 3-4 throw pillows in mixed textures (leather, linen, wool)
Style coffee table with books, sculptural objects, and greenery
Add 2-3 more substantial plants in industrial planters
Include table lamp or floor lamp for additional light source
Add wall shelving with curated objects and books
Include throw blanket draped on seating
